title: Circle of Live at Cervantino
excerpt: The second Mexican Circle of Live night, presented with MUTEK MX at the Festival Internacional Cervantino.
description:
The second Mexican Circle of Live night, presented as MUTEK MX x Festival Internacional Cervantino on 12 October 2025, two days after the Nocturne session in Mexico City. Same collaboration, different room: real-time visuals and light from me, choreography by Alejandra Metztli.
> A set built for one venue has to be rebuilt for the next, and what survives the move is the part that was really the work. Here the point clouds met a proper theatre, with the audience seated in front of the stage rather than circling it.
credits: Real-time visuals and light: Jaco Schilp / Studio Schilp. Choreography: Alejandra Metztli. Circle of Live: Sebastian Mullaert, Pantha du Prince and Leafar Legov. MUTEK MX x Festival Internacional Cervantino, 12 October 2025.
